catalog.summary: Searches and picks remote records like people.

reference: Salesforce lightning-record-picker and the SLDS Lookup, Fluent UI v8 BasePicker and NormalPeoplePicker, Fluent UI v9 TagPicker, Microsoft Graph Toolkit mgt-people-picker, MUI Autocomplete, React Aria Autocomplete, Ant Design Select with remote search
patternStatus: The combobox pattern owns the input and both key tables, the listbox pattern the popup, and the grid pattern the row of chips in multiple, as in multi-select. The three pages were transcribed for combobox and multi-select (specs/components/multi-select/contract.json); design §2 lists the rows this family answers differently or adds.

entity-picker.reason: The search session, the cache of seen entities, the resolution of ids, the sections and the decision a key makes are the same in both bindings, and a third copy of the combobox keyboard only stays aligned with the other two when it is written and tested once (design §1.5).

anatomy.root: a div carrying data-ui=entity-picker, data-size, data-variant, data-selection-mode and data-overflow; role=group named by the field's label when scopes are shown. The scope and the control share one line at every width
anatomy.scope: a div around the select family, drawn before the control and joined to it, min(11rem, 45%) wide; only when scopes are given
anatomy.control: the frame: edge, ground, shadow, focus ring and invalid edge, as text-field and combobox draw it; it holds the values, the input and the two buttons
anatomy.selection: single: the chosen entity's avatar before the input, aria-hidden because the input already says the name
anatomy.values: multiple: role=grid, carrying the field's label and the count of chips; the frame's buttons stay outside it, because a grid owns rows and nothing else
anatomy.chips: multiple: the row of chosen entities, role=row. Each chip is a tag root (data-ui=tag, data-part=root, role=gridcell) — the chip is tag's, as in multi-select — with an avatar in tag's start part, the label, and tag's remove button at tabindex=-1; data-loading while its id resolves, data-unresolved when the source did not return it
anatomy.field: multiple: the gridcell that holds the input
anatomy.input: the text field, role=combobox; spellcheck=false and autocorrect=off unless the consumer asks for the check (React spellCheck, Angular spellcheck), since it searches names
anatomy.clear: the button that empties the choice and the text
anatomy.trigger: the button that opens and closes the popup, tabindex=-1
anatomy.busy: the spinner family's ring inside trigger while a search or a resolution is travelling
anatomy.positioner: the portalled layer, carrying data-ui=entity-picker so the stylesheet reaches it
anatomy.content: the listbox; aria-multiselectable in multiple; aria-busy while loading; the container the row reflows in
anatomy.group: a section (favorites, recent, results) or a group of results, role=group named by its group-label
anatomy.group-label: the heading of a group; drawn only when more than one group is showing
anatomy.item: one entity, role=option; data-create for the offer to create, data-retry for the offer to search again
anatomy.media: the avatar family, spanning the label and the description
anatomy.label: the entity's name, ordered by its own first strong character and aligned with the page, clamped to two lines
anatomy.match: the highlight family inside label, from the collator the local source used or the query the remote one answered
anatomy.description: the identifier that disambiguates, one line, ordered by its own first strong character
anatomy.meta: a short trailing text: a type, a status
anatomy.indicator: the check on a chosen option
anatomy.error: the sentence that says the search failed, above the retry option
anatomy.empty: the sentence that says nothing matched
anatomy.placeholder: three rows in the shape of an entity row, drawn by the skeleton family while the first page loads; aria-hidden
anatomy.more: one skeleton row at the end while the next page loads; aria-hidden
anatomy.status: the live region: the count, the wait, the minimum length, the error

portalledIdentity.reason: As combobox records it: the family is two subtrees and a stylesheet cannot reach a popup portalled out of its root.

branches: the control root, so pressing the trigger again closes rather than dismissing twice
layer.reason: One layer in the single stack, at the token combobox and select use.

highlight.focus: stays on the input for the whole interaction with the popup
highlight.reason: The combobox pattern requires it, and the input must keep focus for the reader to type.

wiring.aria-expanded: true while the popup is open, false while it is closed, always written on the input
wiring.aria-controls: the input names the content while the popup is open
wiring.aria-activedescendant: the input names the highlighted option, and nothing while there is none
wiring.aria-autocomplete: list, always; inline completion is declined
wiring.aria-multiselectable: true on the content in multiple, absent in single
wiring.aria-selected: true on every chosen option, false on every other selectable one
wiring.aria-disabled: on an entity marked disabled, and on every unchosen option while max is reached
wiring.aria-busy: on the content while the first page loads, and on the input while an id of the value resolves
wiring.aria-setsize: on each option when the result carries total
wiring.aria-label: on values in multiple, carrying the field's label and the count of chips; on each chip, the entity's name, its description and the remove key
wiring.aria-describedby: the input takes the field's description and error
wiring.tabindex: -1 on the trigger and on every remove button
wiring.hidden inputs: React: one per id, all under the same name

optionParts: renderOption (React) and the slEntityPickerOption template (Angular) write an option's content with EntityPickerOptionLabel / Description / Meta / Media and slEntityPickerOptionLabel / Description / Meta / Media, which carry data-part and its selector key, so the content takes the row's columns; with media=none the option's own face goes in the media part
virtualize: above 100 options in a list with no section headings only the options in view and 6 either side are drawn, between two spacers sized from measured rows (estimatedRowHeight, 48, until measured); options carry aria-posinset and aria-setsize; a highlight outside the window scrolls the list to it first. virtualize=false draws every option, true windows a shorter list too

entity.avatar: { src?, name?, shape?, surface? } — surface as avatar names it, plate for a logo made for a white ground; omitted, the avatar shows the initials of label; null takes the media column away from that entity
entity.reason: Salesforce's display-info names a primary field and one additional field; Fluent's Persona a text and a secondary text. description is the additional field and the disambiguator, meta a short trailing fact that is not an identifier.

value.single: an id, a string or null
value.multiple: an array of ids, in the order the reader chose them
value.request: the change request carries entities, the known entities of the requested value, so the normalised object reaches the consumer without a second API
value.query: the text typed since the last choice. Opening with the chosen name in the field searches the empty string, so the popup shows favorites and recent rather than one row
value.close: single closes on a choice; multiple stays open, empties the query and keeps the highlight

source.search: search(request, { signal }) returns a promise of a result, as DataGridDataSource.getRows does
source.resolve: resolve(ids, { signal }) returns the entities for ids the cache does not hold; optional, and without it an unknown id is unresolved at once
source.local: items instead of source filters locally through localEntitySource, with the collator of @slotted/core/collection over label and description
source.stale: each request is aborted when a newer one starts, and an answer that arrives after it is ignored by its sequence number
source.delay: searchDelay milliseconds after the last keystroke, 250 by default; an empty query and a change of scope search at once
source.minimum: below minQueryLength characters the family does not search and status says how many are needed
source.more: when the result says hasMore, the next page is asked for as the last option comes into view, with page + 1 and the cursor the result returned
source.reason: The family calls the adapter, so the delay and the abort are the family's: combobox declines debounce because there the fetch is the consumer's.

sections.empty: an empty query shows, in multiple, the chosen entities first, then favorites, then recent, then the results of the empty query when minQueryLength is 0
sections.typed: a typed query shows only the results, grouped by entity.group in the order each group first appears
sections.dedupe: an id shown in an earlier section is never repeated in a later one
sections.scope: with a scope chosen, favorites and recent show only entities of that scope or of none
sections.headings: a group-label is drawn only when more than one group is showing
sections.cache: every entity the family has seen is kept by id, so a new search never erases the name of a chip

creation.element: an option of its own, marked data-create, after the results
creation.appears: while onCreate is given, the query is not empty, the search has answered, and no result's label equals the query under the collator
creation.effect: calls onCreate with the query; when it resolves to an entity, the family caches it and adds its id to the value with reason submit
creation.reason: The value is an id and the entity created arrives with it, so the family can finish the choice, which combobox cannot because its collection is the consumer's.

overflow.collapse: createCollapse from @slotted/core/overflow hides the chips that do not fit on the control's one line, writing hidden on each; the count chip, a tag root with data-count in tag's outline variant, says +N and opens the popup, whose chosen section holds every chosen entity
overflow.wrap: multi-select's rows: the chips wrap onto three lines, then the row scrolls
overflow.reason: A field in a form is one row tall beside its neighbours; a chosen set that wraps makes it two or three rows tall as values are added, which the reviewer refused at the visual gate. wrap stays for a panel where height is free.

error.retry: an option marked data-retry below the error sentence: ArrowDown reaches it, aria-activedescendant names it, Enter or a press repeats the request
error.previous: the results of the failed search's predecessor are not shown as if they answered this one
error.reason: A button inside a listbox popup is not reachable while focus stays on the input; an option is, through the machinery creation already uses.

resolve.pending: a chip whose id is resolving is a skeleton the width of a short name, data-loading, and keeps its remove button, so it can be taken out before it resolves and does not grow when it does; in single the trigger shows the busy ring and the input is empty with aria-busy
resolve.missing: an id the source did not return is a chip reading the unresolved message with data-unresolved, removable, whose name carries the id
resolve.validity: the Angular Validator reports unresolved while any id of the value is missing
resolve.batch: ids unknown at the same moment are resolved in one call

busy.reason: The chevron says the popup opens onto something; while an answer is travelling the ring replaces it, as in combobox.

placeholder.reason: The first page waits as three rows in the anatomy of an entity row: a circle where the avatar goes, a line for the name, a shorter one for the identifier. The loaded list occupies the same boxes.

more.reason: The next page waits as one row after the last, so the rows above it do not move.

refresh.reason: A new query with rows already on screen keeps those rows, dimmed, with aria-busy on the content, and swaps them when the answer arrives. Replacing them with the skeleton on every keystroke is the flicker the loading-states skill names; the skeleton answers only a popup with nothing painted.

timing.reason: An answer inside 200 ms draws no indicator; an indicator once drawn stays 400 ms. searchDelay runs before the request, this delay after it starts.

keyboard.effect: closed, opens and highlights the first option; open, moves the highlight to the next option, wrapping only when loop is true
closed, opens and highlights the last option; open, moves to the previous option
on an entity: single chooses it and closes, multiple toggles it and empties the query; on the create option calls onCreate; on the retry option repeats the search; with no highlight, nothing
open, closes and keeps the text; closed, single puts the chosen name back and clears the choice when the text already was that name, multiple empties the text
on the input, the browser's caret movement; on a chip, the first chip
keyboard.focus: the input, or the first chip

keyboard.effect: on the input, the browser's caret movement; on a chip, the input
moves the highlight ten options on, or to the last, without wrapping
moves the highlight ten options back, or to the first, without wrapping
on the input, the caret; from the start of the query in multiple, the last chip, mirrored under dir=rtl; on a chip, the previous chip
on the input, the caret; on a chip, the next chip, and the input after the last, mirrored under dir=rtl
on the input with text, the browser's deletion; in multiple with an empty query, the first press moves focus to the last chip and removes nothing, the second removes it; on a chip, removes it
keyboard.focus: the chip that took the removed one's index, then the previous chip, then the input

keyboard.effect: on a chip, removes it; on the input, the browser's deletion
keyboard.focus: the chip that took the removed one's index, then the previous chip, then the input

keyboard.effect: typed into the input, which starts the delayed search; on a chip, focus returns to the input and the character is typed there
closes without choosing and leaves the control; the popup, the chips and the remove buttons are outside the tab sequence
keyboard.focus: the next element in the page

focus.onOpen: nothing moves; the highlight goes to the first chosen option in single, and to nothing otherwise
focus.roving: the chips in multiple, one tab stop for the control
focus.removal: createRemovalFocus from @slotted/core/focus: the chip that took the index, then the previous, then the input
focus.disabledItems: an entity marked disabled keeps its place, carries aria-disabled and data-disabled, and is skipped by every movement key

opening.input: typing into the input opens the popup, and so does a press on the input; a Tab into the input does not, because a reader tabbing through a form is passing the control on the way to the next field
opening.focus: every focus on the input opens the popup, a Tab into it and a press on it alike. For a control that is the reason the page exists, such as a search field alone in a header
opening.manual: only the trigger, ArrowDown, ArrowUp and Alt+ArrowDown open the popup; typing filters without opening it
opening.press: a pointer press on the input opens a closed popup with reason pointer, under input and focus, and never closes an open one, because a press there also places the caret. Under manual it only places the caret. A consumer handler that calls preventDefault on the click keeps the popup closed
opening.reason: React Aria names the same three values in menuTrigger and defaults to input; Base UI (openOnInputClick) and Ark (openOnClick) open on a press on the input. combobox, multi-select and entity-picker answer both gestures alike, so one form holding the three opens on the same gestures

messages: the number of results, once the search has answered
the minimum length, while the query is shorter
an entity added in multiple, with the count now chosen
an entity removed in multiple, with its name and the count left

form.react: one visually hidden input per id, all under the same name, with required and form on the first
form.reason: Neither ecosystem has the other's mechanism.

positioning.anchor: the control, not the root, so the popup lines up with the text and not with the scope

motion.reason: The grammar every anchored layer in this library uses.

inlineCompletion.reason: Two entities can carry the same name; completing the text in the field would claim an identity that only the list, with its identifiers, shows.

customValue.reason: Free text as the value is combobox with allowsCustomValue. This family's value is an id; creation is the path for a value the source does not hold.

virtualization.reason: As combobox defers it. hasMore is the incremental answer.

reorder.reason: No surveyed entity picker reorders its chips; an ordered set of strings is multi-select's.

personCard.reason: MGT opens a person card from a chip. renderChip composes hover-card around the chip; what a card shows is the product's.

favoriteMark.reason: A star on a favorite row needs a star glyph the foundation does not have. The Favorites heading says it; a new glyph changes the foundation and is not justified by this family alone.

paste.reason: Pasting a list of addresses is a search per token, which is the consumer's through onCreate. multi-select and tags-input own pasting strings.

modal.reason: As combobox: inerting the page would inert the input the reader types into.

--slotted-entity-picker-scope-inline-siz.reason: select has no intrinsic width (its first track is minmax(0, 1fr)); 11rem holds "Opportunities" at lg, and 45% leaves the field the larger share at 240 pixels.

--slotted-entity-picker-meta-measure.reason: A short fact read with the name; past eight of its own letters it is cut before the name is.

--slotted-entity-picker-field-min.reason: multi-select's floor: a couple of characters of caret room, which the collapse reserves before it keeps a chip.

--slotted-entity-picker-field-basis.reason: multi-select's basis: a word's worth of room under overflow="wrap".

--slotted-entity-picker-measure.reason: The widest a width="content" popup grows: a name, an address and a fact on one row.

--slotted-entity-picker-icon-size-min.reason: combobox's floor under the glyph scale at dense (SL3).
